source.title: Provide canonical manual non-prompt C2 intake and start helper
source.objective: Provide and enforce one canonical writer-backed helper for manual non-prompt C2 registration plus executor_started. Verify writer receipt and canonical work_item_id before starting work; preserve the observed local-only item and rejected #5407/#5435 as evidence. Coordinate with the existing web/ChatGPT intake item without assuming shared implementation.

work_item_evidence.value_json: {"chat_url": null, "code_location": null, "description": "Manual non-prompt C2 registration path is fragile: c2_intake.py add writes a local roadmap.sqlite directly, but does not submit the intake through the canonical single writer. A work item created this way (wi:ee525059023d407ab0fdca10fb3b6c12) was absent from origin/main, so later c2_executor_started (#5407) and c2_executor_result (#5435) were rejected as not_planned. Impact: an executor can follow the apparent local intake/start flow, perform real work, and only discover later that canonical C2 never registered the item. Provide/enforce one canonical helper for non-prompt intake + executor_started.", "executor": null, "executor_ref": null, "issue_id": "issue:29a4606547f04677a0f861836cfb480b", "observed_at_ms": 1790675255110, "origin_run_id": null, "origin_work_item_id": null, "repo": "https://github.com/gernalix/codex-roadmap"}
